notes.title: Easy mode and language update!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/-p5aW1LV_39I/VWL6h2pE7nI/AAAAAAAAAlg/7vZ6D3iPA2o/w599-h337-no/updateNEW.png[/IMG]

Hi spies!

Happy to announce a new update with some new features and improvements. 


- NEW DIFFICULTY MODE

We heard that some people found the game a bit hard because this game IS hard. That's why we have added a new "normal" difficulty mode that keeps the game challenging and makes it more accessible for every kind of player.

Those who played the game in the original (harder) mode will keep the save with everything. New players will find that a few achievements are only achievable in hard mode.

- 4 NEW LANGUAGES

We just added 4 new languages: French, German, Italian and Spanish.

- SOME MINOR STUFF

We worked a bit on graphics, fixed some bugs and worked on optimization to make the experience cooler and smoother :)
